# Scanned-page fixtures: attribution

Every page here was drawn by `make-scans.ts` for IncarnaMind's OCR comparison (#397); `set.json` holds each page's expected text, and `read.json` what the built-in text recognition model read on it. All text is synthetic, written for this project; no third-party text is reproduced. People, companies, places and figures are fictional.

The pages were drawn locally with @napi-rs/canvas, using macOS's system fonts (Times New Roman, Georgia, Arial, Songti, Hiragino Sans GB and STHeiti) for drawing only: no font file is embedded or redistributed. The noisy pages' rotation, blur, uneven light, noise and specks come from a seeded generator.

These files are released under the repository's Apache-2.0 licence.
